name: Fixyno Core
author: netcreator

sections.description:
Fixyno Core is the official optional companion plugin for the Fixyno
Appliance Repair WordPress theme (slug: fixyno-appliance-repair). It
adds a structured Services Custom Post Type (CPT) with taxonomies,
service-card meta fields, and helper functions that Fixyno theme templates
consume to render themed home-service and HVAC service cards.

Fixyno Core stores everything in standard WordPress wp_posts +
wp_postmeta tables, which means your service content is portable — it
survives theme switches. If you ever move off Fixyno, all of your service
descriptions, featured images, prices and categories are preserved and can
be migrated anywhere.

What this plugin actually does

  • Registers the Services custom post type (fixyno_service):
    title, editor, featured image, excerpt, custom-fields, revisions,
    page-attributes, and full block-editor (REST API) support.
  • Registers Service Categories (hierarchical taxonomy, like Post
    Categories) → fixyno_service_cat
  • Registers Service Tags (flat taxonomy, like Post Tags) →
    fixyno_service_tag
  • Adds two Service editor meta boxes with 6 sanitized meta fields:
    • Material Symbols icon name (used when no Featured Image exists)
    • Corner badge text — “Most Requested”, “Gas Certified” etc.
    • Starting price / price range — “From $79” or “$79 – $199”
    • Custom CTA button label — “Book Service”, “View Details”
    • Custom CTA URL — replaces default single-service permalink
    • Featured features list — one bullet per line, renders as checklist
  • Adds 5 extra admin columns on the Services list screen: Icon preview,
    Badge, Price, Service Categories, and Featured Image thumbnail.
  • Enqueues Material Symbols font on the Service editor admin screen ONLY
    (so icon name previews render as the correct glyph in admin columns;
    ZERO front-end / public asset enqueues from this plugin).
  • Provides 3 public helper functions for Fixyno theme templates:
    fixyno_core_get_service_meta(),
    fixyno_core_get_service_features_array(), and
    fixyno_core_get_service_card_cta().
  • Registers a lightweight Dashboard → Fixyno Core “About” admin page
    with setup documentation, feature overview, and next-step links.

Theme compatibility

This plugin only exposes data and helpers. It does NOT output anything
visible on public site front-ends by itself. Visual rendering is done
100% by the Fixyno Appliance Repair theme’s templates. Installed on a
site that does not use Fixyno, the plugin activates cleanly and does
nothing beyond registering the post type + taxonomies.

Important

This plugin is COMPLETELY OPTIONAL. The Fixyno Appliance Repair theme
works 100% standalone without it — the home Services section simply uses
six Customizer-editable cards instead. No nags, no required activation,
no notices for non-admin users.

Plugin principles

  • No external API calls, no remote assets loaded on public front-ends.
  • Zero tracking, zero telemetry, zero data collection of any kind.
  • Every public-facing meta output is escaped (esc_html, esc_url,
    esc_attr, esc_textarea) by the helper functions / save callbacks.
  • Every save callback is gated by nonce + user-capability check +
    post-type guard + revision/autosave filter.
  • Single text domain fixyno-core with
    Domain Path: /languages — works with the WordPress.org language-pack
    system when translations are contributed.
  • Activation hook flushes rewrite rules (CPT permalink base /service/
    plus taxonomies /service-category/ and /service-tag/).
sections.installation:
Automatic installation via WordPress.org plugins directory

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New.
  2. In the search box type “Fixyno Core” and hit Enter.
  3. Click Install Now next to the Fixyno Core plugin by Netcreator.
  4. Click Activate Plugin. A new “Services” menu appears in the admin
    sidebar.

Manual installation via Upload Plugin button

  1. Download fixyno-core.zip to your computer.
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New in your WordPress admin.
  3. Click the Upload Plugin button at the top of the screen.
  4. Use the file picker to select the zip you downloaded, then click
    Install Now.
  5. When the installation finishes, click Activate Plugin.

Manual FTP installation

  1. Unzip fixyno-core.zip on your local computer.
  2. Upload the entire fixyno-core/ folder to your
    site’s /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  3. In WordPress admin go to Plugins and click Activate under
    the “Fixyno Core” entry.

After activation

  1. Go to Services → Add New and create your first service.
  2. (Optional but recommended) In Services → Categories and
    Services → Tags organise your services into taxonomy terms.
  3. Open Appearance → Customize → Home → Services and change the
    Data Source dropdown to Services CPT to display CPT items on
    the Fixyno homepage. (If left unset, Fixyno uses its built-in
    Customizer cards as a fallback.)
  4. Publish your site — Fixyno will render the CPT service cards on
    the home page and single-service templates for each entry.
sections.faq:
Do I NEED this plugin to use Fixyno Appliance Repair theme?

No. Fixyno works 100% standalone. The plugin only exists so appliance
repair companies with large service lists can use the power of a real
CPT with taxonomy organization, searchability, and postmeta persistence
across themes. Theme users who want 6 simple service cards will never
need to install Fixyno Core at all.

Can I use this plugin with a different theme?

You CAN activate it safely with any theme (it won’t break anything) but
since all visual rendering is handled by Fixyno templates, there will
be no “styled” output on front-ends with any other theme — just the
bare WordPress single-service archives (like a plain custom post type).

Where are the plugin settings?

There is no settings page. Everything is configured directly in the
Service editor (meta boxes) or on the WordPress Customizer screen of
the Fixyno theme. The Dashboard → Fixyno Core page only shows setup
documentation.

Does this plugin load CSS or JavaScript on my public site?

Absolutely no public assets are enqueued by Fixyno Core. The only
wp_enqueue_style call this plugin makes is on the Service editor
admin screen (inside admin_enqueue_scripts action, filtered by
$screen->post_type === ‘fixyno_service’) to render Material Symbols
glyph previews in admin columns. This never runs for logged-out users
or on the front-end.

Does Fixyno Core phone home?

No. grep the entire plugin — you will find exactly zero wp_remote_*
or curl or file_get_contents(https://...) calls. No pings, no
license checks, no telemetry, no external resource fetches of any
kind (except the Material Symbols admin-only stylesheet, which is from
Google Fonts and loads only for logged-in editors on the Services
screen).

What happens if I deactivate the plugin?

All of your service posts, meta, and taxonomy terms are preserved in
the database exactly as-is. The URLs under /service/ stop working
until you activate Fixyno Core again (or register the same post type
slug via another method). The Fixyno theme silently falls back to
Customizer service cards. No 404s cascade into any other section of
your site.

Is this plugin translatable?

Yes. All user-facing strings use the single text domain
fixyno-core (Text Domain declared in the plugin header,
Domain Path /languages). Translations are loaded with a three-tier fallback:
(1) WordPress.org GlotPress language-pack MO in
WP_LANG_DIR/plugins/ (for w.org installs), (2) local MO inside this
plugin’s /languages/ directory (for manual zip or TGMPA installs before
w.org approval), and (3) a standard language-pack path as last-ditch. The
WordPress.org language-pack system automatically distributes approved
community translations when contributors submit them.

Can I contribute patches or report bugs?

Yes. Pull requests and bug reports are welcomed through the plugin’s
listing page on WordPress.org.
sections.changelog:
1.0.2

  • Removed duplicate Tested up to: 7.1 line from fixyno-core.php plugin
    header. Per WordPress.org Plugin Handbook, Tested up to is declared
    ONLY in readme.txt (L5 in this file) — never in the PHP file header.
    Eliminates precedence conflicts between PHP header value and readme
    value when the plugin page, search results, or compatibility checker
    displays the tested-up version.
  • Version bump 1.0.0 → 1.0.2 for WP.org plugin re-upload (clears the
    “You’ve already uploaded that ZIP file” duplicate-zip hash check).

1.0.0

  • Initial public release of Fixyno Core.
  • Services Custom Post Type (fixyno_service) — full Gutenberg REST
    support, 8 editor + display features, revision support, public
    archive + permalinks.
  • Service Categories taxonomy (fixyno_service_cat) — hierarchical
    with archive permalinks.
  • Service Tags taxonomy (fixyno_service_tag) — flat with archive
    permalinks.
  • 6 sanitized service meta fields: icon, badge, price range, CTA
    label, CTA URL, feature bullet list.
  • 5 custom admin columns for Services list screen + Material Symbols
    admin-only enqueue for icon glyph preview.
  • 3 public helper functions for Fixyno theme template consumption.
  • Dashboard → Fixyno Core About documentation page + Plugins row
    “Manage Services” action link.
  • Activation / deactivation rewrite-rule flush hooks.
  • Text domain fixyno-core with Domain Path
    /languages — translatable via WordPress.org language packs.
  • Zero front-end asset enqueues, zero external API calls, zero
    tracking — fully WordPress.org plugin-review compliant.
